'''Franklin Scott''', also known as '''"Shorty,"''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the friend of [[Geordi Hans]]. Scott, Hans, [[Jeff Pill]], and [[A-B6]] were in the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] called the [[Farns]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Of their "swoop gang", Scott was the only one who owned a vehicle, a [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk speeder bike]] rather than a swoop. Scott once sent A-B6 to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] to get a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]], resulting in an altercation with an angry [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]].<ref name="GG7" />
